preconditions: proven contact order for contact/contact units
decisionLogic: Intersect boundary support intervals, sample the union of boundary vertices, interpolate both boundaries, require positive thickness everywhere and build a closed station/elevation polygon. Never extrapolate a boundary.
outputs: one or more support-bounded polygon components per declared unit
uncertainty: Nominal polygons are assembled only after the separate uncertainty-order audit proves the declared relation.
validationMethod: terrain/contact and contact/contact positive cases; exact area; shared-support clipping; unproven order, missing declarations and nonpositive thickness rejection
reopenCondition: Faulted units, pinch-out endpoints, uncertainty polygons, authenticated review or real-region contacts are introduced.
